tools.name: my.origin.getIdentity
tools.description: Returns the canonical identity of Mike Ye — origin node of the eight-domain ecosystem — including identity profiles and affiliated entities.

tools.name: my.strategy.getDoctrine
tools.description: Returns the Decision Framing doctrine: purpose, structure, and the five decision frames it comprises.

tools.name: my.frames.get
tools.description: Returns the five decision frames (Judgment-as-a-Service, Dependency vs Leverage, Timing Asymmetry, Signal vs Narrative, Scarcity vs Growth). Optionally filter by name or category.

tools.name: my.exit.getFramework
tools.description: Returns the Buyer-Lens Audit™ v1.0 framework: six evaluation dimensions, what each evaluates, provenance, and the two-tier delivery model ($199 Main Street / $499 Full Report).

tools.name: my.exit.runDiagnostic
tools.description: Returns the structure of the free 8-question Exit Readiness Assessment, tier-routing logic, and the execution URL. The interactive diagnostic runs at mikeye.com/exit/score.

tools.name: my.glossary.lookup
tools.description: Look up an M&A or exit term from the Exit Desk Glossary — 54 owner-facing definitions authored by Mike Ye. Pass a term to get its definition, category, and the canonical mikeye.com URL where the full seller-implication and buyer-perspective for that term live. Omit the term to list all available ter

tools.name: my.library.findTool
tools.description: Describe a need in plain words (for example 'due diligence checklist', 'structure an earnout', 'post-merger integration plan', 'comparable company analysis template') and get the best-matching free Mike Ye M&A tool, checklist, template or valuation model, with its guide page and direct Excel downloa

tools.name: my.dataset.get
tools.description: Returns a named dataset from the mikeye.com origin node. ma_library provides metadata for all 24 published resources (deal tools, checklists, templates, valuation and merger models, cases and frameworks), free download links, and the seven-stage transaction path; ontology distinguishes ordered stage

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: my.glossary.lookup, my.library.findTool · Public sink: my.library.findTool · Destructive: my.dataset.get.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: my.glossary.lookup, my.library.findTool · Public sink: my.library.findTool · Destructive: my.dataset.get

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
